verdict.rationale: Brevo's developer docs state it ships official SDKs with full API coverage for Node.js, Python, and PHP, which directly delivers the story. The evidence is a single first-party claim, though. Supporting developer surface (OAuth/API keys, Postman workspace, llms.txt and Markdown docs for agents) adds context. Missing for 10: SDK-specific documentation depth (install/usage guides, versioning), coverage beyond three languages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Official SDKs with full API coverage. Available for Node.js, Python, and PHP.
